title: Subject and Verb
description: Pastikan kalimat punya subject dan verb yang lengkap.

title: Objects of Prepositions
description: Object of preposition bukan subject.

title: Appositives
description: Appositive menjelaskan noun; bukan subject utama.

title: Present Participles
description: Present participle (-ing) sebagai modifier — bedakan dari verb utama.

title: Past Participles
description: Past participle sebagai modifier/passive — bedakan dari verb utama.

title: Coordinate Connectors
description: and, but, or, so, yet — independent clauses.

title: Adverb Time & Cause Connectors
description: when, while, before, after, since, because, as.

title: Other Adverb Connectors
description: although, even though, if, unless, whereas, whether.

title: Noun Clause Connectors
description: that, what, whether, if, how sebagai object/complement.

title: Noun Clause Connector/Subjects
description: what/whether/whoever sebagai subject clause.

title: Adjective Clause Connectors
description: who, which, that, whom, whose, where, when.

title: Adjective Clause Connector/Subjects
description: who/which/that sebagai subject di relative clause.

title: Reduced Adjective Clauses
description: Kurangi adjective clause (who/which/that + be) jadi participle/adjective phrase.

title: Reduced Adverb Clauses
description: Kurangi adverb clause (when/while/because/if + subject + be) jadi participle phrase.

group: Sentences with Inverted Subjects and Verbs
title: Invert with Question Words
description: Do NOT invert in embedded questions (after know, ask, determine, etc.).

group: Sentences with Inverted Subjects and Verbs
title: Invert with Place Expressions
description: Invert after place expressions (here, there, across the valley...).

group: Sentences with Inverted Subjects and Verbs
title: Invert with Negatives
description: Invert after negative/limiting adverbs (never, rarely, not only...).

group: Sentences with Inverted Subjects and Verbs
title: Invert with Conditionals
description: Inverted conditionals: Had I known, Were he here, Should you need.

group: Sentences with Inverted Subjects and Verbs
title: Invert with Comparisons
description: Inversion in comparisons: as does she, than do they.

title: Verbs after prepositional phrases
description: Subject–verb agreement: ignore objects of prepositions between subject and verb.

title: Verbs after expressions of quantity
description: all/most/some/half of… — verb follows the object after of (singular, plural, or uncountable).

title: Agreement with inverted verbs
description: Setelah place/negative/question inversion, verb harus setuju dengan subject yang datang SETELAH verb.

title: Agreement after certain words
description: everybody/anyone/each/every/something… selalu singular secara tata bahasa.

title: Parallel structure with coordinate conjunctions
description: and / but / or harus menghubungkan bentuk yang sejajar (noun–noun, verb–verb, dll.).

title: Parallel structure with paired conjunctions
description: both…and / either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also — pasangan benar + bentuk sejajar.

title: Parallel structure with comparisons
description: more/-er…than, as…as, the same as, similar to — kedua sisi perbandingan harus sejajar.

title: Form comparatives and superlatives correctly
description: -er/more + than · the + -est/most — bentuk comparative & superlative yang benar.

title: Use comparatives and superlatives correctly
description: Comparative = banding 2 hal · Superlative = yang paling di antara banyak.

title: The irregular -er, -er structure
description: the harder…, the further… — dua comparative paralel diawali the.

title: After have, use the past participle
description: have/has/had/having + past participle (V3), bukan V1/V2.

title: After be, use present or past participle
description: be (am/is/are/was…) + V-ing (aktif) atau V3 (pasif).

title: After modals, use the base form
description: will/would/can/must… + V1 (base form), bukan V-ing/V3/Vs.

title: Past with present — logical mixing
description: Jangan campur past & present tanpa alasan logis; periksa makna kalimat.

title: Use have and had correctly
description: have + V3 = past→now · had + V3 = past before past.

title: Correct tense with time expressions
description: ago/last/in → simple past · by → past perfect · since/lately → present perfect.

title: Correct tense with will and would
description: present + will · past + would — jangan campur (kecuali polite would).

title: Correct form of the passive
description: Passive = be + past participle (by + object opsional).

title: Recognize active and passive meanings
description: Subject melakukan aksi → active; subject menerima aksi → passive.

title: Correct singular or plural noun
description: each/every/a/one → singular · many/several/both/two → plural.

title: Countable vs uncountable nouns
description: many/few/number → countable · much/little/amount → uncountable.

title: Irregular plurals of nouns
description: criteria/data/phenomena… plural tanpa -s — verb harus plural.

title: Distinguish the person from the thing
description: Jangan tukar person (authority, accountant) dengan thing (authorization, accounting).

title: Subject and object pronouns
description: I/he/she/we/they = subject · me/him/her/us/them = object (verb atau preposition).

title: Skill berikutnya — coming soon
description: Slot untuk skill Written Expression selanjutnya.
